label: Some bearer of an occurring thought has a concrete ground-ancestor that exists at w and at every…
paraphrase: Some bearer of an occurring thought has a concrete ground-ancestor (possibly itself) that exists at w and at every world accessible from w: de re, relative to the frame's accessibility and to rigid candidate identity. It implies the existing NecessaryConcreteAt on the same profile and world (vocabulary lemma necessaryConcreteAt_of_ancestor, registered as an instantiation result in specs/cogito-ancestor-necessary-concrete.toml). It does not say that this ancestor exists at every world (accessibility need not be universal), is unique, uncaused, simple, intelligent, personal or God, or that the bearer is contingent.
